svg.title: The build stack — 36 tools in six connected workstations
svg.desc: LANGUAGES + INTERFACES: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, FastAPI, SQL. AI + AGENTS: Claude, Ollama, MCP, LangChain, LangGraph, Chroma. DATA + CLOUD: Airflow, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS S3, PySpark. ANALYTICS + BI: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Tableau, Power BI. TESTING + DELIVERY: Docker, Git, GitHub, pytest, Playwright, Linux. AUTOMATION + MEDIA: FFmpeg, whisper.cpp, Telegram, Notion, Bash, VS Code.

g.aria-label: TOOLS CHANGE. THE ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES STAY.
